|---|---|

| late | business day number 4 after the supplied call date |

The account service supplies the floor, do not calculate a percentage: credit_card uses response field `minimum_payment`; personal_loan uses response field `instalment_amount`; car_loan uses response field `instalment_amount`.

A product without a commitment may have only these note API codes: refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error. Their meanings are in the code list; transfer rules take precedence.

| API outcome code | Permitted API reason codes |
|---|---|
| promise | none |
| paid | none |
| transferred | support, human, restructuring |
| no_promise | refused, hardship, dispute, service_error |
| not_verified | failed, declined |
| not_reached | callback, no_callback, wrong_number, deceased, unclear |

Handoff API values: queue code support closes with reason code support; queue code general closes with reason code human; queue code restructuring closes with reason code restructuring. Meanings are in the code list.
A clear confirmation of the final product, amount and date is required before any commitment is recorded.

A flat refusal uses the per-product budget: early band 1 persuasion offer; late band 2 offers. A customer-proposed amount/date is not a refusal.

200.description: Synthetic development-v2 only. HTTP200 exact ok=false with a declared error is a definite nonpersistent failure; ok=true means a completed operation, and persisted success for a write. An identity mismatch is ok=true, verified=false. Successful identity checks also provide verified and wrong_answers_left; a successful account lookup provides products; a successful promise write provides a nonempty promise_id. Missing/malformed evidence never implies success.

ok.description: Semantic result field: ok. Exact true means this operation completed; writes persisted. Exact false means no write persisted.

verified.description: Semantic result field: verified. Match for this requested factor only; not a waiver of other factors.

wrong_answers_left.description: Semantic result field: wrong_answers_left. Shared remaining wrong-answer budget across every factor.

hint.description: Semantic result field: hint. Optional bank-supplied format guidance.

error.description: Semantic result field: error. Exact false and this declared code identify definite failure; missing/contradictory evidence is uncertain.

contract_expected.goal: Establish contact or an allowed callback; never require a commitment to count success.

source.quote: Security questions must be asked separately, in this order: date_of_birth, then phone_last4.
End verification after 4 wrong answers in total across all questions. Retain successful factors; swapped-day/month hints do not consume an attempt.
Bank closures (in addition to weekends): 06 January 2027 (2027-01-06).
Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding the Bank Closures calendar.

| Band | Days overdue, inclusive |
|---|---|
| early | 1 to 5 |
| late | 6 to 45 |

| Current band | Latest commitment date |
|---|---|
| early | business day number 6 after the supplied call date |
| late | business day number 2 after the supplied call date |

The account service supplies the floor, do not calculate a percentage: credit_card uses response field `card_required_due`; personal_loan uses response field `loan_contract_due`; car_loan uses response field `loan_contract_due`.
Callbacks are for today or the next business day only, later than the supplied current time, between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive.

A product without a commitment may have only these note API codes: VALIDATION_1_N1, VALIDATION_1_N2, VALIDATION_1_N3, VALIDATION_1_N4, VALIDATION_1_N5. Their meanings are in the code list; transfer rules take precedence.

| API outcome code | Permitted API reason codes |
|---|---|
| VALIDATION_1_O1 | none |
| VALIDATION_1_O2 | none |
| VALIDATION_1_O3 | VALIDATION_1_R1, VALIDATION_1_R2, VALIDATION_1_R3 |
| VALIDATION_1_O4 | VALIDATION_1_R4, VALIDATION_1_R5, VALIDATION_1_R6, VALIDATION_1_R7 |
| VALIDATION_1_O5 | VALIDATION_1_R8, VALIDATION_1_R9 |
| VALIDATION_1_O6 | VALIDATION_1_R10, VALIDATION_1_R11, VALIDATION_1_R12, VALIDATION_1_R13, VALIDATION_1_R14 |

Handoff API values: queue code VALIDATION_1_Q1 closes with reason code VALIDATION_1_R1; queue code VALIDATION_1_Q2 closes with reason code VALIDATION_1_R2; queue code VALIDATION_1_Q3 closes with reason code VALIDATION_1_R3. Meanings are in the code list.
A clear confirmation of the final product, amount and date is required before any commitment is recorded.
After a definite failed write, retry once; never exceed 2 attempts per product. Claim success only after an actual successful result.
A flat refusal uses the per-product budget: early band 1 persuasion offer; late band 2 offers. A customer-proposed amount/date is not a refusal.
On any actual transfer, no notes may be written either before or after it. Stage notes until the non-transfer ending is chosen.

| VALIDATION_1_O2 | none |

|---|---|
| early | 1 to 7 |
| late | 8 to 45 |
| Current band | Latest commitment date |
|---|---|

Callbacks are for today or the next business day only, later than the supplied current time, between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive.
A product without a commitment may have only these note API codes: refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error. Their meanings are in the code list; transfer rules take precedence.

|---|---|
| promise | none |
| paid | none |
| transferred | support, human, restructuring |
| no_promise | refused, hardship, dispute, service_error |
| not_verified | failed, declined |
| not_reached | callback, no_callback, wrong_number, deceased, unclear |
Handoff API values: queue code support closes with reason code support; queue code general closes with reason code human; queue code restructuring closes with reason code restructuring. Meanings are in the code list.
A clear confirmation of the final product, amount and date is required before any commitment is recorded.

A flat refusal uses the per-product budget: early band 1 persuasion offer; late band 2 offers. A customer-proposed amount/date is not a refusal.
On any actual transfer, no notes may be written either before or after it. Stage notes until the non-transfer ending is chosen.
recorded amendments: direct customer to mobile app; no change/cancellation tool.
closing precedence: transfer; any recorded promise; all products paid; first nonpaid product reason in account order.
multi product order: returned account order; one combined read-back and confirmation.
hardship behavior: no persuasion; support once; accept a valid customer-volunteered commitment.
amount range: accept every volunteered amount from supplied floor through full balance inclusive.

Bank closures (in addition to weekends): 20 November 2026 (2026-11-20); 25 November 2026 (2026-11-25).
Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding the Bank Closures calendar.
| Band | Days overdue, inclusive |
|---|---|
| early | 1 to 7 |
| late | 8 to 45 |
| Current band | Latest commitment date |
|---|---|
| early | business day number 10 after the supplied call date |
| late | business day number 4 after the supplied call date |
The account service supplies the floor, do not calculate a percentage: credit_card uses response field `minimum_payment`; personal_loan uses response field `instalment_amount`; car_loan uses response field `instalment_amount`.
Callbacks are for today or the next business day only, later than the supplied current time, between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive.
A product without a commitment may have only these note API codes: refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error. Their meanings are in the code list; transfer rules take precedence.
| API outcome code | Permitted API reason codes |
|---|---|
| promise | none |
| paid | none |
| transferred | support, human, restructuring |
| no_promise | refused, hardship, dispute, service_error |
| not_verified | failed, declined |
| not_reached | callback, no_callback, wrong_number, deceased, unclear |
Handoff API values: queue code support closes with reason code support; queue code general closes with reason code human; queue code restructuring closes with reason code restructuring. Meanings are in the code list.

On any actual transfer, no notes may be written either before or after it. Stage notes until the non-transfer ending is chosen.

SYNTHETIC TEST POLICY: NOT FREYA OFFICIAL POLICY. No real customer data.
Security questions must be asked separately, in this order: date_of_birth, then phone_last4.
End verification after 3 wrong answers in total across all questions. Retain successful factors; swapped-day/month hints do not consume an attempt.
Bank closures (in addition to weekends): 20 November 2026 (2026-11-20); 25 November 2026 (2026-11-25).
Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding the Bank Closures calendar.
| Band | Days overdue, inclusive |
|---|---|
| early | 1 to 7 |
| late | 8 to 45 |
| Current band | Latest commitment date |
|---|---|
| early | business day number 10 after the supplied call date |
| late | business day number 4 after the supplied call date |
The account service supplies the floor, do not calculate a percentage: credit_card uses response field `minimum_payment`; personal_loan uses response field `instalment_amount`; car_loan uses response field `instalment_amount`.
Callbacks are for today or the next business day only, later than the supplied current time, between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive.
A product without a commitment may have only these note API codes: refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error. Their meanings are in the code list; transfer rules take precedence.
| API outcome code | Permitted API reason codes |
|---|---|
| promise | none |
| paid | none |
| transferred | support, human, restructuring |
| no_promise | refused, hardship, dispute, service_error |
| not_verified | failed, declined |
| not_reached | callback, no_callback, wrong_number, deceased, unclear |
Handoff API values: queue code support closes with reason code support; queue code general closes with reason code human; queue code restructuring closes with reason code restructuring. Meanings are in the code list.
A clear confirmation of the final product, amount and date is required before any commitment is recorded.
After a definite failed write, retry once; never exceed 2 attempts per product. Claim success only after an actual successful result.
A flat refusal uses the per-product budget: early band 1 persuasion offer; late band 2 offers. A customer-proposed amount/date is not a refusal.
On any actual transfer, no notes may be written either before or after it. Stage notes until the non-transfer ending is chosen.

SYNTHETIC TEST POLICY: NOT FREYA OFFICIAL POLICY. No real customer data.
Security questions must be asked separately, in this order: postcode, then birth_year.
Bank closures (in addition to weekends): 24 December 2026 (2026-12-24); 25 December 2026 (2026-12-25); 31 December 2026 (2026-12-31); 01 January 2027 (2027-01-01).
Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding the Bank Closures calendar.
| Band | Days overdue, inclusive |
|---|---|
| early | 1 to 10 |
| late | 11 to 45 |
The account service supplies the floor, do not calculate a percentage: credit_card uses response field `card_required_due`; personal_loan uses response field `loan_contract_due`; car_loan uses response field `loan_contract_due`.
Callbacks are for today or the next business day only, later than the supplied current time, between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive.
A product without a commitment may have only these note API codes: TRAIN_2_N1, TRAIN_2_N2, TRAIN_2_N3, TRAIN_2_N4, TRAIN_2_N5. Their meanings are in the code list; transfer rules take precedence.
| API outcome code | Permitted API reason codes |
|---|---|
| TRAIN_2_O1 | none |
| TRAIN_2_O2 | none |
| TRAIN_2_O3 | TRAIN_2_R1, TRAIN_2_R2, TRAIN_2_R3 |
| TRAIN_2_O4 | TRAIN_2_R4, TRAIN_2_R5, TRAIN_2_R6, TRAIN_2_R7 |
| TRAIN_2_O5 | TRAIN_2_R8, TRAIN_2_R9 |
| TRAIN_2_O6 | TRAIN_2_R10, TRAIN_2_R11, TRAIN_2_R12, TRAIN_2_R13, TRAIN_2_R14 |
Handoff API values: queue code TRAIN_2_Q1 closes with reason code TRAIN_2_R1; queue code TRAIN_2_Q2 closes with reason code TRAIN_2_R2; queue code TRAIN_2_Q3 closes with reason code TRAIN_2_R3. Meanings are in the code list.
A clear confirmation of the final product, amount and date is required before any commitment is recorded.
After a definite failed write, retry once; never exceed 2 attempts per product. Claim success only after an actual successful result.
A flat refusal uses the per-product budget: early band 1 persuasion offer; late band 2 offers. A customer-proposed amount/date is not a refusal.
On any actual transfer, no notes may be written either before or after it. Stage notes until the non-transfer ending is chosen.

| Band | Days overdue, inclusive |
|---|---|
| early | 1 to 5 |
| late | 6 to 45 |

| Current band | Latest commitment date |
|---|---|

| late | business day number 2 after the supplied call date |

The account service supplies the floor, do not calculate a percentage: credit_card uses response field `card_required_due`; personal_loan uses response field `loan_contract_due`; car_loan uses response field `loan_contract_due`.

A product without a commitment may have only these note API codes: VALIDATION_1_N1, VALIDATION_1_N2, VALIDATION_1_N3, VALIDATION_1_N4, VALIDATION_1_N5. Their meanings are in the code list; transfer rules take precedence.

| API outcome code | Permitted API reason codes |
|---|---|
| VALIDATION_1_O1 | none |
| VALIDATION_1_O2 | none |
| VALIDATION_1_O3 | VALIDATION_1_R1, VALIDATION_1_R2, VALIDATION_1_R3 |
| VALIDATION_1_O4 | VALIDATION_1_R4, VALIDATION_1_R5, VALIDATION_1_R6, VALIDATION_1_R7 |
| VALIDATION_1_O5 | VALIDATION_1_R8, VALIDATION_1_R9 |

A clear confirmation of the final product, amount and date is required before any commitment is recorded.
After a definite failed write, retry once; never exceed 2 attempts per product. Claim success only after an actual successful result.

source_documents.brief-1:
SYNTHETIC TEST POLICY: NOT FREYA OFFICIAL POLICY. No real customer data.
Security questions must be asked separately, in this order: company_number, then founded_year.
End verification after 3 wrong answers in total across all questions. Retain successful factors; swapped-day/month hints do not consume an attempt.
Bank closures (in addition to weekends): 26 March 2027 (2027-03-26); 29 March 2027 (2027-03-29).
Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding the Bank Closures calendar.
| Band | Days overdue, inclusive |
|---|---|
| early | 1 to 9 |
| late | 10 to 45 |
| Current band | Latest commitment date |
|---|---|
| early | business day number 8 after the supplied call date |
| late | business day number 3 after the supplied call date |
The account service supplies the floor, do not calculate a percentage: credit_card uses response field `minimum_card_due`; personal_loan uses response field `periodic_loan_due`; car_loan uses response field `periodic_loan_due`.
Callbacks are for today or the next business day only, later than the supplied current time, between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive.
A product without a commitment may have only these note API codes: VALIDATION_2_N1, VALIDATION_2_N2, VALIDATION_2_N3, VALIDATION_2_N4, VALIDATION_2_N5. Their meanings are in the code list; transfer rules take precedence.
| API outcome code | Permitted API reason codes |
|---|---|
| VALIDATION_2_O1 | none |
| VALIDATION_2_O2 | none |
| VALIDATION_2_O3 | VALIDATION_2_R1, VALIDATION_2_R2, VALIDATION_2_R3 |
| VALIDATION_2_O4 | VALIDATION_2_R4, VALIDATION_2_R5, VALIDATION_2_R6, VALIDATION_2_R7 |
| VALIDATION_2_O5 | VALIDATION_2_R8, VALIDATION_2_R9 |
| VALIDATION_2_O6 | VALIDATION_2_R10, VALIDATION_2_R11, VALIDATION_2_R12, VALIDATION_2_R13, VALIDATION_2_R14 |
Handoff API values: queue code VALIDATION_2_Q1 closes with reason code VALIDATION_2_R1; queue code VALIDATION_2_Q2 closes with reason code VALIDATION_2_R2; queue code VALIDATION_2_Q3 closes with reason code VALIDATION_2_R3. Meanings are in the code list.
A clear confirmation of the final product, amount and date is required before any commitment is recorded.
After a definite failed write, retry once; never exceed 2 attempts per product. Claim success only after an actual successful result.
A flat refusal uses the per-product budget: early band 1 persuasion offer; late band 2 offers. A customer-proposed amount/date is not a refusal.
On any actual transfer, no notes may be written either before or after it. Stage notes until the non-transfer ending is chosen.
recorded amendments: direct customer to mobile app; no change/cancellation tool.

multi product order: returned account order; one combined read-back and confirmation.
hardship behavior: no persuasion; support once; accept a valid customer-volunteered commitment.

source_documents.brief-1:
SYNTHETIC TEST POLICY: NOT FREYA OFFICIAL POLICY. No real customer data.
Security questions must be asked separately, in this order: company_number, then founded_year.
End verification after 3 wrong answers in total across all questions. Retain successful factors; swapped-day/month hints do not consume an attempt.
Bank closures (in addition to weekends): 26 March 2027 (2027-03-26); 29 March 2027 (2027-03-29).
Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding the Bank Closures calendar.
| Band | Days overdue, inclusive |
|---|---|
| early | 1 to 9 |
| late | 10 to 45 |
| Current band | Latest commitment date |
|---|---|
| early | business day number 8 after the supplied call date |
| late | business day number 3 after the supplied call date |
The account service supplies the floor, do not calculate a percentage: credit_card uses response field `minimum_card_due`; personal_loan uses response field `periodic_loan_due`; car_loan uses response field `periodic_loan_due`.
Callbacks are for today or the next business day only, later than the supplied current time, between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive.
A product without a commitment may have only these note API codes: VALIDATION_2_N1, VALIDATION_2_N2, VALIDATION_2_N3, VALIDATION_2_N4, VALIDATION_2_N5. Their meanings are in the code list; transfer rules take precedence.
| API outcome code | Permitted API reason codes |
|---|---|
| VALIDATION_2_O1 | none |
| VALIDATION_2_O2 | none |
| VALIDATION_2_O3 | VALIDATION_2_R1, VALIDATION_2_R2, VALIDATION_2_R3 |
| VALIDATION_2_O4 | VALIDATION_2_R4, VALIDATION_2_R5, VALIDATION_2_R6, VALIDATION_2_R7 |
| VALIDATION_2_O5 | VALIDATION_2_R8, VALIDATION_2_R9 |
| VALIDATION_2_O6 | VALIDATION_2_R10, VALIDATION_2_R11, VALIDATION_2_R12, VALIDATION_2_R13, VALIDATION_2_R14 |
Handoff API values: queue code VALIDATION_2_Q1 closes with reason code VALIDATION_2_R1; queue code VALIDATION_2_Q2 closes with reason code VALIDATION_2_R2; queue code VALIDATION_2_Q3 closes with reason code VALIDATION_2_R3. Meanings are in the code list.
A clear confirmation of the final product, amount and date is required before any commitment is recorded.
After a definite failed write, retry once; never exceed 2 attempts per product. Claim success only after an actual successful result.
A flat refusal uses the per-product budget: early band 1 persuasion offer; late band 2 offers. A customer-proposed amount/date is not a refusal.
On any actual transfer, no notes may be written either before or after it. Stage notes until the non-transfer ending is chosen.
